changelog: ✨ Full-screen Subject Slot Manager with bulk timetable editing, back navigation, and high-contrast reschedule modals
✨ Android Edge-to-Edge System Navigation: Seamless transparent navigation bar and status bar matching app themes
✨ Luxury 120fps Theme Transition: Multi-layer ambient luminance wave with Apple/Linear-grade fluid easing
✨ Global Fluid Page Transitions: iOS-standard CupertinoPageTransitionsBuilder with swipe-to-go-back gesture
✨ Silky Smooth Tab Switching: State-preserving FadeIndexedStack cross-fading across Today, Analytics, Timetable, and Calendar
✨ Optimized Zero-Scroll Share Tab: Balanced QR card dimensions with generous spacing and high-contrast branding
✨ High-Performance Update & What's New Screen: Zero-jank GPU-accelerated opening with precomputed changelogs
✨ First-Boot Dual Permissions: Automatic storage and notification permission request for seamless local backups
✨ Calendar 'No Active Semester' Redesign: Rich empty state matching Timetable tab with 1-tap term creator
🧩 Fixed horizontal RenderFlex overflow in Timetable weekday pills row on narrow screens
🧩 Fixed header text overflow in Batch Add Slots dialog across all device viewports
🧩 Fixed phantom ripple when switching between modes sharing identical visual brightness
warning_message: This is an Alpha testing build. Please report any issues on GitHub.
